name: Za'tachk Interstellar Ground Force
description: The Za'tachk army — planetary surface actions, battles and campaigns, largely fought through remotely operated drones. A Za'tachk career (Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4). Commission also requires BOL 6 or lower.

support.name: Support
support.description: You are an engineer, cook or in some other role behind the front lines.

light_jockey.name: Light Drone Jockey
light_jockey.description: You are trained in controlling the light drones of the ground force.

heavy_jockey.name: Heavy Drone Jockey
heavy_jockey.description: You are trained in controlling the heavy drones of the ground force.

6.title: Xok
6.bonus: SOC 10 or SOC +1, whichever is higher

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You garrison on a major military base with recreational facilities. Gain one of Carouse, Gambler, Streetwise or Survival.
events.4: Stationed at a boring billet, you take up gambling. Roll BOL 8+: succeed for D3 additional Benefit rolls this term; fail and lose your Benefit this term. Either way, gain one level in Gambler.
events.5: Your drone is caught between two fighting units. Stand and fight your way out with Electronics (remote ops) 8+: succeed and gain one of Drive (any), Electronics (any) or Flyer (any); fail and lose your Benefit this term.
events.6: Your CO selects you for advanced training. Roll BOL 8+ to gain one of Admin 1, Advocate 1, Electronics 1, Engineer 1 or Mechanic 1.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You lead a commended surgical strike. Gain one of Leadership, Tactics (military), or DM+4 on your next Advancement roll.
events.9: You discover your superior is involved in crime. Cover for them and gain them as an Ally; or turn them in with BOL 8+ — succeed and you are commended (auto-advance or gain a commission), fail and you cannot roll for advancement or commission this term. Either way, gain the officer as an Enemy.
events.10: You serve as your CO's executive assistant. Roll EDU 6+ to gain Admin 1.
events.11: A rival challenges you to a test of skill. Refuse and lose SOC -1. Accept and roll your highest skill 8+: fail and lose all benefits this term; succeed for DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: Your innovative tactic proves exceptionally effective in an exercise. You are either promoted or automatically commissioned to officer rank.

mishaps.1: Severely injured (treat as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: Your unit's drones are demolished in a disastrous battle, which you blame on your CO. Gain them as an Enemy as they have you removed from the service.
mishaps.3: Ordered onto a black-ops mission against your conscience, you refused and were ejected from the service.
mishaps.4: You quarrel with a superior officer. Gain the officer as a Rival as they drive you out of the service.
mishaps.5: You destroy a fellow soldier's drone in friendly fire. Roll Advocate 8+: succeed and you are not charged but forced out; fail and you are charged and forced out. On a natural 2 you must take the Prisoner career next term. Either way, gain the fellow as an Enemy.
mishaps.6: You are wounded in the line of duty. Roll on the Injury table.
